quote: Max thinking lifts S 2.1’s score on Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 60.4% to 70.2% and on DeepSWE from 16.5% to 40.4%.
notes: Poolside launch post states Laguna S 2.1 has two thinking modes: off and max (enabled by default); released without user-configurable low/medium/high control. In thinking-off mode, S 2.1 scored 16.5% (plotted as ~17% with 99k mean completion tokens/trajectory) in the pool harness, compared to 40.4% at max thinking (~249k completion tokens).
